name: Kiskutas (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kiskutas (a blue and red shield with a white bough and a well) above a yellow scroll inscribed KISKUTAS 1211.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
